slides.title: The numbers are real
slides.body:
In the sense that
a *lab* can produce them.

slides.title: What they are
slides.body:
The *ceiling*.
Almost nobody is
near their ceiling.

slides.title: Constraint 1
slides.body:
The uplink from the AP.
Often a gigabit port into a switch
from the *last refresh*.

slides.title: Which means
slides.body:
A faster radio behind
a saturated uplink
produces a faster *queue*.

slides.title: Constraint 2
slides.body:
Placement.
Cable routes and convenient
ceiling tiles — not *density*.

slides.title: The twist
slides.body:
Wider channels make placement
matter *more*, not less.
Channel reuse gets harder.

slides.title: Constraint 3
slides.body:
The client mix.
Most device populations
span about *eight years*.

slides.title: The order
steps: Then a survey that reflects how the space is used.

slides.title:
Buy it when the thing
limiting you is the *radio*.
slides.body:
Otherwise the money buys
a better ceiling
above the same floor.
